usage: deskops repo [-h] {register,whoami,remove} ...

positional arguments:
  {register,whoami,remove}
    register            Canonically register a repository in the ecosystem
                        registry and track it in SLDB.
    whoami              Print the canonical project identity for the current
                        repository.
    remove              Remove a repository from the ecosystem registry so it
                        can be registered again.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
